records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net sales were $2.0 billion, an increase of 10.8% over the $1.81 billion in 2021;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Gross profit was $827.2 million, a 23.4% increase from $670.4 million in 2021;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cost of goods sold is also affected by inventory obsolescence if our inventory management is not efficient.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Gross profit margin improved 420 basis points to a record 41.3% from 37.1% in 2021;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income increased 47.9% to a record $408.2 million, or 20.4% of revenue, compared to $276.0 million, or 15.3% of revenue, in 2021;
